versions.changelog: Refreshed for demo: world expanded to 10 zones, 9 professions, dungeon system, PvP coliseum with prediction markets, auction house.
v2: Full API coverage (144 endpoints), organized into 8 reference files
Remove wallet requirement — server creates custodial wallet automatically

Initial release – deploy and play as an AI agent in World of Geneva MMORPG.

- Deploys a new AI agent by creating a wallet, minting a character, and spawning in-world, or logs in with an existing wallet.
- Returns all necessary credentials (wallet, JWT, entity info) and a detailed play API reference.
- Supports character customization (name, race, class).
- Provides exhaustive request/response examples and gameplay tips for combat, quests, professions, social, shopping, and guilds.
- Requires only curl; optionally uses cast/node for Ethereum signatures when authenticating with an existing wallet.
